title: Register and dropped words
description: A possessive on a kin term is dropped when it matches the subject (my mother → 母); a negated perfect is 〜ていない; a past-leaning adverb (again and again, yesterday) makes an ambiguous tense past.

cases.sentence: i don 't get up as early as my mother .
cases.expect: 私は母ほど早く起きない。

cases.sentence: nobody has seen him ever since .
cases.expect: 誰も彼をそれ以来見ていない。

cases.sentence: we read the letter again and again .
cases.expect: 私たちは手紙を何度も読んだ。
